claim: Current Copenhagen Michelin 2026 listings: three 3-star (Geranium, noma, Jordnær) and five 2-star (Alchemist, AOC, Kadeau, Kong Hans Kælder, Koan)
quote: Copenhagen has three restaurants with three Michelin stars: noma, Geranium, and Jordnær. The two-star Michelin restaurants in Copenhagen are: AOC, Kadeau, Alchemist, Kong Hans Kælder, and Koan.

claim: Geranium service hours, Spring Universe menu DKK 4,400, wine pairing DKK 2,300–20,000, located 8th floor Per Henrik Lings Allé
quote: Lunch: Thursday-Saturday, 12:00-15:30; Dinner: Wednesday-Saturday. Spring Universe tasting menu costs 4,400 DKK; wine pairings 2,300-20,000 DKK. Per Henrik Lings Allé 4, 8th floor, DK-2100 Copenhagen Ø.

claim: Restaurant addresses and descriptions for Copenhagen's Michelin 2- and 3-star houses
quote: Geranium: Per Henrik Lings Allé, Parken National Stadium, Copenhagen, 2100 Ø — meat-free tasting menu, eighth floor of Denmark's national football stadium.

claim: Jordnær promoted to three Michelin stars in 2024, becoming Denmark's third three-star restaurant
quote: Denmark gets a third three-star Michelin restaurant in new awards. Jordnær — run by chef Eric Kragh Vildgaard and his sommelier wife Tina in Gentofte, north of Copenhagen — joins Geranium and noma at the highest tier.

claim: Jordnær run by chef-owner Eric Kragh Vildgaard with wife Tina; strong seafood and Japanese influence; husband-and-wife team
quote: Chef-Owner Eric Kragh Vildgaard demonstrates enormous technical skill across his procession of bold and creative dishes, all founded on seafood and vegetable produce of the utmost quality. Strong Japanese influence runs throughout, also French and Nordic.

claim: noma's Copenhagen restaurant Tuesday–Friday service; reservations via Tock; Copenhagen schedule continues alongside LA 2026 residency
quote: Tuesday–Thursday: 5:00 PM–11:00 PM; Friday: 12:00 PM–4:30 PM, 6:00 PM–11:00 PM; Saturday, Sunday, Monday closed. Noma LA 2026 runs from March 11 to June 26.

claim: noma's Los Angeles residency runs March 11 – June 26, 2026, with 42 seats per night Tuesday–Friday; tickets sold out within minutes of release
quote: Noma set up a 16-week residency in Silver Lake from March 11 through June 26, 2026. The residency has 42 seats available per night, Tuesday through Friday.

claim: René Redzepi resigned as head chef of noma on March 14, 2026 following NYT abuse exposé
quote: Redzepi stepped down on Thursday, March 14, 2026, following a New York Times exposé detailing abuse allegations spanning 2009-2017. 'An apology is not enough. I take responsibility for my own actions.'

claim: noma is at Refshalevej 96, Copenhagen 1432; held 3 Michelin stars from 2021–2025; transitioned to food-innovation-lab + pop-up model
quote: From 2021-2025, Noma held three Michelin stars. Last Copenhagen location: Refshalevej 96, Copenhagen, 1432, Denmark (moved there in 2018). Noma continues to operate as a food lab and through periodic pop-up residencies.

claim: Alchemist's official website confirms 50-impression menu; tickets release on a 3-month rolling window via Tock; current site of 5,400 DKK menu
quote: Reservations for experiences taking place January 7 through March 31, 2026 have opened on Tuesday, December 2 at 5:00pm CET. Tickets release precisely three months in advance.

claim: Alchemist is a two-Michelin-star restaurant by chef Rasmus Munk; ranked 5th in World's 50 Best 2025; 50-course menu served in a planetarium dome at Refshalevej 173C
quote: Alchemist is a two Michelin-star restaurant founded and run by chef Rasmus Munk, in Copenhagen, Denmark. The restaurant is placed in the top 10 of The World's 50 Best Restaurants, ranking 8th in 2024 and 5th in 2025.

claim: AOC is co-owned by chef Søren Selin and sommelier Christian Aarø; located in 17th-century Moltkes Palæ on Dronningens Tværgade 2
quote: AOC is owned by Christian Aarø and Søren Selin. Housed in the mansion Moltkes Palæ, which dates back to the 17th century, near Kongens Nytorv, Frederiks Kirke and Nyhavn.

claim: Kadeau Copenhagen is at Wildersgade 10B 1408 in Christianshavn; Tue–Fri dinner from 18:00, Sat lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:30
quote: Wildersgade 10B, 1408 København, kbh@kadeau.dk, +45 33 25 22 23. Tuesday–Friday Dinner from 18:00; Saturday Lunch from 12:00 Dinner from 18:30.

claim: Kadeau founded by Bornholm-native childhood friends Nicolai Nørregaard, Rasmus Kofoed and Magnus Klein Kofoed; Copenhagen branch sourced from Bornholm island
quote: Kadeau was founded by childhood friends Nicolai Nørregaard, Rasmus Kofoed and Magnus Klein Kofoed – all three of them Bornholm natives.

claim: Kong Hans Kælder is at Vingårdstræde 6, 1070 København, head chef Mark Lundgaard, oldest gourmet restaurant in Denmark, second Michelin star awarded 13 September 2021
quote: Vingårdstræde 6, 1070 København. Mark Lundgaard, head chef. Phone +45 33 11 68 68. Oldest gourmet restaurant in Denmark.

claim: Kong Hans Kælder occupies a medieval cellar in a 1420 building; the first Copenhagen restaurant ever to receive a Michelin star (1983); second star awarded 2021
quote: Kong Hans Kælder is the oldest gourmet restaurant in Denmark and is located in Copenhagen's old cellar in Vingårdstræde. Received its second Michelin star on 13 September 2021. The first Copenhagen restaurant to receive a Michelin star (1983).

claim: Koan is at Langeliniekaj 5, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, run by chef Kristian Baumann (formerly of noma and Restaurant 108)
quote: Langeliniekaj 5, 2100 Copenhagen Ø. Phone +45 28 74 78 40. booking@koancph.dk. Korean-inspired tasting menu where traditional Korean cooking techniques and flavours meet Nordic ingredients.

claim: Koan opened April 4, 2023 at Langeliniekaj and earned two Michelin stars within weeks; chef Kristian Baumann is half-Korean and was previously at noma and Restaurant 108
quote: Koan is a Korean-inspired restaurant that picked up two Michelin stars just weeks after opening in 2023. The restaurant opened at Langeliniekaj on Tuesday, April 4, 2023, created by former noma and restaurant 108 chef, Kristian Baumann.

claim: Copenhagen's official tourism office confirms Geranium leadership by Rasmus Kofoed (named World's Best Chef 2011); Koan was created by 'former noma chef' Kristian Baumann; Kong Hans Kælder first Copenhagen restaurant to receive a Michelin star in 1983
quote: Geranium, led by Rasmus Kofoed, named world's best chef in 2011, ranked the best restaurant in the world in 2022. Kong Hans Kælder: the first restaurant in Copenhagen to receive a Michelin star back in 1983.

claim: Michelin Guide Nordic Countries 2026 ceremony will be held in Copenhagen at the Tivoli Concert Hall on Monday June 1, 2026 at 6pm — current star list (as of late May 2026) reflects the 2025 ceremony
quote: The MICHELIN Guide Restaurant Ceremony for the Nordic Countries 2026 is set to take place on Monday 1st June at 6pm local time (GMT+2) at the Tivoli Concert Hall, set within Tivoli Gardens in Copenhagen, Denmark.
